title: A CoreMIDI port reports closed when its endpoint was replaced, so owners reconnect

needles: CoreMIDI input reports closed when its source is replaced, and reopens

installed_sdk.rationale: No installed header, target or exported symbol changes in this file. The macOS backend gains an AppKit link for the wake notification, which is internal to the already-shipped MIDI library.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag or handler is added or changed. The change is inside the CoreMIDI device backend.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation or executor binding changes. MidiInput::is_open() and MidiOutput::is_open() keep their signatures; they now also report false when the endpoint was replaced.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No capability is added, removed or re-keyed. Public MIDI and audio headers changed elsewhere in this branch are classified as infrastructure in the public-surface ledger; this backend file is not a public header.
